Shared runtime and tokens: The 12 kB budget of SPEC §14.3; fixed by the spec, and not raised for a component.
Form control base and field styles (shar: A shared base, counted in each form control's own entry; within 5 kB.
Modal controller and overlay stack (shar: A shared base, counted in the window and the dialog; within 5 kB.
Roving controller (shared by tabs, toolb: A shared base, counted in tabs, toolbar, and accordion; within 5 kB.
Close button and status shapes (shared b: A shared base, counted in the window, toast, fields, and connection row; within 5 kB.
Localization runtime and locale watcher: What Lit Localize's `msg` and the locale watcher add to each entry that renders a message (Phase 4 §14.1); within 5 kB.
Selectable base and receptacle (shared b: A shared base, counted in slot, item stack, and recipe; within 5 kB.

punk-slot-grid: Within the 5 kB budget of SPEC §14.3; the limit is the measured size plus about 6%, rounded up to 0.25 kB.

punk-connection-row: Over 5 kB: the close button and status shapes are 3.3 kB of it (their shared entry), the localization runtime is 0.41 kB, and the stacked layout needs its own grid rules (Phase 4 §14.3, §14.6, §14.8). No room is left.
punk-tooltip: Within the 5 kB budget of SPEC §14.3; the limit is the measured size plus about 6%, rounded up to 0.25 kB.
punk-stack: Within the 5 kB budget of SPEC §14.3; the limit is the measured size plus about 6%, rounded up to 0.25 kB.
punk-cluster: Within the 5 kB budget of SPEC §14.3; the limit is the measured size plus about 6%, rounded up to 0.25 kB.
punk-accordion (both tags): Within the 5 kB budget of SPEC §14.3; the limit is the measured size plus about 6%, rounded up to 0.25 kB.
punk-tabs (both tags): Over 5 kB: two components in one entry, with the panel ownership and activation logic and the tab and tab list styles, none of which another entry shares (Phase 3 §11.3).
punk-toolbar: Within the 5 kB budget of SPEC §14.3; the limit is the measured size plus about 6%, rounded up to 0.25 kB.
punk-window: Over 5 kB: the shared modal surface, controller, and styles are about the dialog's whole size, and the window adds the close button, dragging, move mode, and the titlebar wrap; the shared part is counted in each entry, so splitting it out would make neither smaller (Phase 3 §11.4, §11.12).
punk-dialog: Within the 5 kB budget of SPEC §14.3; the limit is the measured size plus about 6%, rounded up to 0.25 kB. It is at 4.91 kB of 5.
punk-popover: Over 5 kB: the anchor wiring, the two focus modes, the menu keys, and light dismissal are in one component, and the shared modules it imports are about 2.5 kB of it (Phase 3 §11.5).
punk-toast and punk-toast-stack: Over 5 kB: two components in one entry, with the countdown, the status shapes, the close button, and both sets of styles; the shared parts are counted in each entry, so there was nothing to split out (Phase 3 §11.6).
punk-checkbox: Within the 5 kB budget of SPEC §14.3; the limit is the measured size plus about 6%, rounded up to 0.25 kB.
punk-switch: Within the 5 kB budget of SPEC §14.3; the limit is the measured size plus about 6%, rounded up to 0.25 kB.
punk-slider: Over 5 kB: the form base (about a third of it), the pointer and key handling, and the host-attribute ownership are all its own (Phase 3 §11.7).
punk-text-field: Over 5 kB: the form base and field styles are about 4.4 kB of it and are counted in each form control, and the localization runtime is 0.47 kB (Phase 3 §11.8, Phase 4 §14.1).
punk-number-field: Over 5 kB: the form base and field styles (about 4.4 kB), the steppers and their repeat logic, and the localization runtime (Phase 3 §11.8, Phase 4 §14.1).
punk-select: Over 5 kB: the form base and field styles (about 4.4 kB), the observer and option copying, and the localization runtime (Phase 3 §11.8, Phase 4 §14.1).
punk-icon-button (includes the tooltip): The documented exception of Phase 1 §10.6: it includes the tooltip that supplies its accessible description, the button base, and the localization runtime.
